g.text: Hard workloads: Sol native vs Sol + Nemotron
12/12 trials complete. Nemotron: 10 editor requests across 4/6 combined trials. Exploratory workflow comparison; no general performance claim.
Times include planning, execution, checks, review, repair and grading. Scope reduced during execution; prior observations retained.
Bars score external checks. Complete delivery also requires successful execution, visible checks and reviewer acceptance.
